title: Smooth projective surfaces with bounded cohomology property II
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective surface with Picard number two, where either $X$ is a geometrically ruled surface or the closed Mori cone is rational polyhedral. In this paper, we characterize $X$ with the bounded cohomology property, i.e., there exists a constant $c_X>0$ such that $h^1(\mathcal O_X(C))\le c_Xh^0(\mathcal O_X(C))$ for every curve $C$ on $X$.
